newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Capital Asia places HK$123 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Capital Asia places HK$123 mln shares.

text.p: Capital Asia Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to issue 95.51 million new shares or 16.08 percent of its enlarged share capital at HK$1.30 each to third party investors.
The company said the net proceeds of about HK$123.5 million would be used to fund acquisition and expansion of marine product, apparel and financial services related businesses.
It said proceeds would also be used to reduce borrowings and for working capital.

A property and investment unit of China's Hainan provincial government, a unit of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd, and China National Cereals, Oils & Foodstuffs Import & Export Corp's Top Glory Holdings Co Ltd will each take a 4.02 percent stake in Capital Asia, the statememt said.

China Pacific Insurance Co Ltd, which engages in the insurance business in China, has agreed to buy another 2.41 percent, and a Hong Kong-based firm Welkinford Ltd will take a 1.61 percent stake, it said.
Trading of Capital Asia shares resumed on Thursday after a one-day suspension, falling HK$0.03 to HK$1.69 in early trade.
